svg.title: Inside tsr_core
svg.desc: tsr_core has three external interfaces: the CSR port, done and one memory port per channel. tsr_csr holds the CSRs and PERF counters and starts tsr_cmdproc, which decodes the instructions that tsr_fetch prefetches from channel 0, runs every check and dispatches one instruction at a time to tsr_dma, tsr_qact or tsr_mvm. All three units read and write the 4 MiB tsr_spm. One tsr_mem_arb per channel merges the fetch (channel 0 only), DMA and weight-stream sources onto that channel's memory port.
